findings.description: Critical: `_extract_supervisor_record` fails to extract `supervisor_record` from standard handoff read responses where the `handoffs` array sits at the root of the response dictionary (`{"handoffs": [...]}` or `{"success": true, "handoffs": [...]}`). Because `_extract_supervisor_record` only checks `value.get("data")`, top-level response payloads fail extraction and return `None`. Consequently, `/supervise` rehydration from `--handoff` responses always falls back to the mirror and reports `Degraded: handoff` even when the coordinator read succeeded.
findings.resolution: Update `_extract_supervisor_record` in `skills/supervise/scripts/cycle_state.py` to inspect `value.get("handoffs")` at top level as well as `(value.get("data") or {}).get("handoffs")`.

findings.description: Critical: `precompact_handoff.py` and `deregister_agent.py` hooks fail to pass through `supervisor_record` when building `/handoffs/write` payloads, violating `specs/skill-workflow/spec.md` and work package tasks 2.5/2.6. `precompact_handoff.py` explicitly iterates only over `("completed_work", "in_progress", "next_steps", "decisions", "relevant_files")`, omitting `supervisor_record`. `deregister_agent.py` sends a fixed handoff payload without extracting the latest phase record. Any compaction or session end event strips the supervisor record, dropping supervisor state across session transitions.
findings.resolution: Update `precompact_handoff.py` and `deregister_agent.py` (and mirror copy `agent-coordinator/scripts/deregister_agent.py`) to extract `supervisor_record` from the latest phase record when present and include it in the `/handoffs/write` payload.

findings.description: none: Migration 034 cleanly drops the 8-argument `write_handoff` overload before adding the defaulted 9-argument function, preventing Postgres RPC resolution ambiguity, and includes a check constraint enforcing that `supervisor_record` is a JSON object or NULL.

none: `supervisor-record.schema.json` defines a strict versioned inner contract (`schema_version: 1`) with `additionalProperties: false` across all sections, validating required fields such as pending gate deadlines while allowing schema evolution without DB migration.
none: `_safe_mirror_path` and `_atomic_write_text` in `cycle_state.py` provide clear, well-structured helper logic for verifying repository boundaries and performing atomic file updates.
